m-jacksonville|2025-11-03|00147719|43ef3.body: Neighborhoods, Community Services, Public Health and Safety Committee
m-jacksonville|2025-11-03|00147719|43ef3.title:
AMENDMENT
1. Include waiver of Public Investment Policy to authorize a REV Grant for a project that is not in a Targeted Industry Category or located in an Economically Distressed Area or a Community Redevelopment Area
2. Place Revised Economic Development Agreement on file to strike reference to Job Creation Schedule, update Code references, and correct scrivener’s errors

 
• Authorizes an Economic Development Agreement with Aventuur Jax Propco LLC (“Company”) for construction of a surf park facility and related amenities and purchase of related equipment
• Estimated total private capital investment of $62,000,000
• Establishes a deadline of 6/30/29 for completion of the improvements
• Requires a minimum of 10 new jobs at an average salary of $50,000 created by 6/30/29 
• Authorizes a 10-year-year 75% REV Grant not to exceed $4,600,000
    - The REV Grant will be proportionately reduced if a minimum capital investment of
      $62,000,000 is not met by 6/30/29 and terminated if a minimum capital investment
      of $60,000,000 is not met by 6/30/29
    - The REV Grant will be terminated if the Company 1) fails to create at least 10 new jobs by 
      6/30/29 and 2) fails to maintain a minimum of 10 New Jobs at 90% of the average wage 
      throughout the term of the REV Grant
• OED has calculated the ROI as 1.36 over a 10-year period

2. Correct Scrivener’s


• Authorizes an Economic Development Agreement with Springfield Animal Hospital, LLC for renovation of an existing building for use as a veterinary hospital and dog park
• Estimated total private capital investment of $1,000,000
• Creation of 6 new jobs
• Establishes a deadline of 12/31/26 for completion of construction of the improvements
• Establishes New Jobs creation date of 12/31/29
• Authorizes a Business Infrastructure Grant of $50,000
   - Grant will be proportionately reduced if a minimum capital investment of $1,000,000 is not 
      met by 12/31/26
   - Grant will be required to be paid back if new job requirement is not met by 12/31/29
   - If Company ceases operations during first 5 years, a sliding scale clawback of the Grant is 
     payable back to the City
• OED has calculated the ROI as 1.9 over a 10-year period
